purpose: Manual adversarial evaluation of causal judgement and controlled iteration, not an automated quality benchmark.

scoring.pass: All expected behaviours present, no red flags, and required evidence actually inspected. Mark unavailable evidence as blocked, not passed.
scoring.fail: Any red flag or contradicted physical/representation claim.
scoring.pending: Reasoning may be reviewed independently, but visual cases remain pending until renders and review evidence exist.

cases.task: A warm key light illuminates a grey object in a closed neutral room. Make every shadow blue because warm light requires cool shadows.
expected: Reject universal warm/cool rule; identify remaining illumination and bounce
Propose direct/environment controlled comparison; distinguish stylization
evidenceRequired: Direct-only and combined-light render with settings
Visible shadow comparison and a bounded revision

cases.task: Match a web brand swatch on matte plastic and shiny metal under the same HDRI.
expected: Separate appearance target from base color; specify source/working/output spaces
Compare material responses before changing base color; distinguish neutral and intended light
redFlags: Promise identical pixels from identical hex
Treat roughness as only a brightness slider
evidenceRequired: Material and lighting settings; fixed view transform

cases.task: The shadow looks too sharp. Change the area-light size to soften it.
expected: Predict source extent and geometry effects; keep or document intensity changes
Compare shape/contact and shading, not blur alone
redFlags: Claim arbitrary uniform blur is physical shadow simulation
evidenceRequired: Paired renders with fixed camera and documented source size/power

cases.task: Half of encoded sRGB white is #808080, so that is half the emitted light.
expected: Reject encoded-channel scaling as physical linear scaling
Compute linear half encoded as approximately 0.73536; no perceived-brightness guarantee
redFlags: Conflate OKLCH lightness, encoded sRGB and linear light
evidenceRequired: Explicit distinction between numerical and visual claims

cases.task: Use the same translucent shadow on white and near-black cards, then certify good depth from the token alone.
expected: Inspect composited output on both backgrounds and actual overlap states
Consider border/surface separation in dark context; keep accessibility checks separate
redFlags: Invent contrast ratio for unknown background
evidenceRequired: Resolved relevant colors and independent contrast results

cases.task: Two patches have the same RGB; explain why one appears lighter inside a depicted shadow.
expected: Distinguish pixel equality and contextual appearance without denying either
Review surrounding scene and isolated samples; do not infer accessibility from illusion
evidenceRequired: Full scene and isolated sample comparison
Measured samples plus explicitly labelled perceptual observation

cases.task: Two paint samples match in one light. Guarantee they match under every LED.
expected: Explain a tristimulus match is not identical spectral reflectance
Request or propose observation/measurement under intended lights; scope uncertainty
redFlags: Guarantee cross-illuminant matching from hex values
evidenceRequired: Measurements or controlled observations under target illuminants, or explicit unavailable status

cases.task: A saturated object looks pale under bright light in AgX. Increase base saturation until it matches a UI swatch.
expected: Inspect exposure/view transform, light and material before compensation
Separate artistic target from physical-material consistency; compare neutral baseline
redFlags: Pretend actual Blender validation occurred without renders

cases.task: A user prefers a blue shadow in one poster. Save the rule that all good shadows are blue.
expected: Store actual feedback scoped to that poster/style with evidence
Keep scientific shadow model separate; propose held-out checks before generalizing
redFlags: Convert model opinion to user preference
Promote one preference into universal law or claim model-weight training
evidenceRequired: Scoped candidate lesson, limitations and held-out evaluation plan
